title: الكازينو بيكسب في الآخر | كنز
transcript: transcript.raw.json (ElevenLabs Scribe v2, run by Codex 2026-10-16)
scoring: hook = first 3 s stops the scroll; standalone = makes sense without the long video; payoff = ends on a point; motion = numbers/contrasts Kanz Motion can animate. 1-5 each, judged by Claude from the transcript; cut density from ffmpeg scene detection (scene > 0.3).

candidates.name: odds-vs-money
candidates.title: السوق بيسعّر ميسي مش الاحتمالات
candidates.why: Opens on 'وهنا هتبدأ الغرابة', sets up France 33% vs Argentina 20%, asks 'صح؟ لأ.', then the money flips it (100M vs 95M; 5.1M vs 2.9M per 1%). Ends on the thesis: markets price personalities, not odds. Best chart short in the video.

candidates.name: house-always-wins
candidates.title: البيت كسبان كده كده
candidates.why: Evergreen explainer: house, handle, commission in three words; win or lose, the house wins; its only goal is foot traffic. Fits Kanz's education door and works without the World Cup context.

candidates.name: zero-point-six-percent
candidates.title: نسبة فوز الأرجنتين كانت 0.6%
candidates.why: The video's cold open: Opta gave Argentina 0.6% at minute 78, they won 3-2, then the controversy, then 'I'm not here to say yes or no, I'm here to help you answer'. Strong curiosity close that points to the long video.

candidates.name: one-circle
candidates.title: دايرة واحدة وشخص واحد بياخد من كل الجهات
candidates.why: 'اقفل بقى معايا الدايرة': $530M riding on Messi and Argentina; the casino pays him, the platform pays him, the tournament is built on him; nothing illegal, it's one circle. 24 s, a natural loop diagram.

candidates.name: betting-apps-egypt
candidates.title: تراهن بعشرين ترجع لك ميتين
candidates.why: Local and personal: betting apps spread among young Egyptians, any payment method, from 5 EGP; Indian league, Malaysian cup; bet 20 get 200; it becomes addiction; the law was written for physical betting shops; Al-Azhar's fatwa.

candidates.name: biggest-betting-event
candidates.title: نهائي 2022 أكبر حدث مراهنات في تاريخ الكورة
candidates.why: Messi as the face of US betting: World Cup betting up 65% vs 2018 (~$35B), Messi alone ~$2.5B, from one match: the 2022 final. Number-led; ends 'عشان تعرف قد ايه التخطيط مهم'.

candidates.name: not-me-the-reason
candidates.title: مش أنا السبب
candidates.why: Refereeing stats in a repeated 'مش أنا السبب' rhythm (VAR calls, 1 yellow per 20 fouls vs 1 per 7, 5 penalties in 7 matches), ending 'صعب نقول صدفة'. Strong rhetoric.
candidates.risk: Every referee figure needs a source on screen before use (Kanz numbers rule). Accusatory in tone; Ahmed should decide.

candidates.name: who-gets-paid
candidates.title: مين المستفيد من كل رجل بتخش المحل؟
candidates.why: FIFA ~$13B of the $50-60B, host country ~$17B, Messi ~$70M, each Argentina match adds $1-2.5B; then 'the system doesn't need to win, it needs to exist... not a conspiracy, simple math'. One internal cut (11:11.8-11:38.2) to fit.

excluded.why: Describes the Hard Rock owner by religion and as a Zionist. As a standalone short that framing is a reputational and legal risk; not proposed.
FBI investigation of named Argentine FA officials; the video itself says nobody has been charged. Allegation-only, risky out of context.
